collection.title: Ford Streetka 2002 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Streetka 2002 - 2006 model requires a 19" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
